engine.label: Execution engine
engine.hint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.

acpCommand.label: ACP server command
acpCommand.hint: Optional override for the Gemini ACP server command. Defaults to gemini --acp.

sessionMode.label: ACP session mode
sessionMode.hint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.

permissions.label: ACP non-interactive permissions
permissions.hint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.

stateDir.label: ACP state directory
stateDir.hint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip-managed organization/agent scoped storage.

warmIdle.label: ACP warm process idle ms
warmIdle.hint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.

instructionsFile.label: Agent instructions file
instructionsFile.hint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Gemini prompt at runtime.
